name: teslafi-mcp
description: Query your TeslaFi vehicle data: live status, drive and charge history, home-to-work commute analysis, and opt-in vehicle commands.
long_description: An MCP server for the TeslaFi API. Exposes live/last-known vehicle data (feed.php), stored drive and charge history (history.php), home-to-work commute analysis built on drive history, and vehicle control commands (disabled by default; opt-in). Requires a TeslaFi API token from https://teslafi.com/api.php.

api_token.title: TeslaFi API Token
api_token.description: Your TeslaFi API token, generated at https://teslafi.com/api.php (Settings -> TeslaFi API).

enable_commands.title: Enable vehicle commands
enable_commands.description: Maps to TESLAFI_ENABLE_COMMANDS. When off (the default), the server is read-only and tesla_send_command returns an instructive error instead of contacting your car. When on, commands must ALSO be enabled per-command on the Commands tab at https://teslafi.com/api.php.

units.title: Units
units.description: Maps to TESLAFI_UNITS. Default unit system for physical quantities when a tool call does not pass `units`. One of: automatic, metric, imperial. 'automatic' (the default) defers to your TeslaFi account's measure setting (then metric). The OS locale is not visible to the server, so this is the way to pin a default. 'metric' uses km, °C, bar; 'imperial' uses mi, °F, psi.

enable_update_check.title: Check for updates
enable_update_check.description: Maps to TESLAFI_CHECK_UPDATES. Opt-in and OFF by default. When on, the server makes a single unauthenticated request to api.github.com to read the latest release tag and, if a newer version exists, shows one short notice line in tool output. It sends NO TeslaFi token or vehicle data to GitHub, follows no redirects, and uses no proxy.

tools.name: tesla_get_current_data
tools.description: Live / last-known vehicle data (state, battery, range, charging, location).

tools.name: tesla_get_drives
tools.description: Stored drive history, optionally filtered by date range.

tools.name: tesla_get_charges
tools.description: Stored charge sessions, optionally filtered by date range.

tools.name: tesla_get_trips_for_month
tools.description: All drives in a given calendar month, normalized.

tools.name: tesla_analyze_home_work_trips
tools.description: Count home-to-work and work-to-home commutes in a month.

tools.name: tesla_get_locations
tools.description: Unique locations and visit counts from drive history, including frequently-visited untagged addresses; a named flag marks TeslaFi-tagged locations vs inferred ones.

tools.name: tesla_send_command
tools.description: Send a vehicle control command (disabled by default; requires opt-in). Car commands never wake a sleeping car unless wake_seconds or no_wake=false is passed.
